purpose: Deterministic classification of the current non-.ci worktree for Section A delivery review. This manifest records evidence and scope; it does not authorize staging, committing, publishing, deployment, or database mutation.

source_of_truth_rule.source_claim: contracts/ contains the authoritative, production-level system contracts.
source_of_truth_rule.synchronization_rule: The consistency test compares every maintained contracts/*.md and docs/contracts/<same filename> pair as raw bytes. Raw-byte equality proves synchronization; contracts/README.md and the consistency test establish the source/mirror relationship.
source_of_truth_rule.authority_boundary: Contract authority and mirror synchronization do not authorize staging, committing, publishing, deployment, or database mutation.

classification_definitions.SECTION_A_CANDIDATE: A current path with a direct, evidence-backed relationship to Section A checkpoints A1-A6 and a cited contract clause and test vector. Candidate status is not acceptance or ownership approval.
classification_definitions.EVIDENCE/GOVERNANCE: A policy, contract-acceptance, checkpoint, inventory, or provenance artifact used to support review; it is not implementation authorization.
classification_definitions.OUTSIDE-A: A current path that belongs to another delivery section or a broader capability area and is not included in this Section A candidate boundary.
classification_definitions.RUNTIME-EXCLUDED: A preserved path or tree explicitly excluded from repository delivery evidence. In this manifest, .ci is preserved CI/test evidence and is not characterized as runtime data; data/cyberassess.db is separately the runtime database exclusion.
classification_definitions.UNRESOLVED: A current path whose Section A ownership or checkpoint relationship cannot be established from repository evidence in this pass; it must remain unresolved rather than being guessed into scope.

entry_rules.path_identity: Repository-relative path with the exact case and separators returned by Git.
entry_rules.group_application: Every group metadata field applies to every path in that group's paths array.
entry_rules.required_unique_coverage: After expanding groups, every live non-.ci status/path pair must appear exactly once; no .ci path or runtime database path may appear in entries.
entry_rules.independent_test_exercised_semantics: A declared evidence claim from the review record, not a runtime correlation or proof that the current validator process executed every referenced path. Actual execution evidence is established only by the retained test output and JUnit artifacts.

delivery.github_first_policy: If later authorized, create one grouped Section A commit on the existing branch, verify GitHub first, and mirror the exact verified commit object to GitLab only afterward.
delivery.current_action: Evidence classification only; no commit, push, branch operation, CI mutation, deployment, GitLab operation, or database mutation.
